name: SwatchPicker
summary: A radio group of colours, each named in words.
rungReason: Native radios in a fieldset; each colour's name is its label, so it's never colour alone.

a11y.role: radio (implicit), in a group named by its legend
a11y.name: The colour's name

keyboard.action: Enters the group at the checked option, and leaves it
Check the next or previous option (native; ArrowDown and ArrowUp too)
Check the focused option when none is checked

a11y.targetSize: Each swatch is at least --lue-size-target-min tall

enhancements.fallback: Safari has no forced-colours mode, so nothing to adjust

rules: The checked swatch is marked by a heavier border and bold name, not by its colour
Chips keep their real colour in forced colours: the colour is the content
withoutJavaScript: Works fully, and submits with its form
contrast: A strong border round the checked swatch
forcedColors: The chip keeps its colour with a CanvasText edge; the checked swatch is SelectedItem
